blocks.html: In times of need, you can always count on your go-to hotels to do what they do best — hospitality. Hospitality is making your guests feel like they’re home. It’s that one thing that buffers our stress, boredom, exhaustion and yes, fear. Fear of contracting the deadly coronavirus.

During the onslaught of the pandemic, hotels have been the people’s refuge all around the globe. From sheltering healthcare workers to providing additional beds for overwhelmed hospitals, these safe havens have also served as the “home away from home” not just for returning OFWs, but also those who are considered PUI (persons under investigation) and PUM (persons under monitoring).

Here in the Philippines, local governments have been working with hotels to transform the buildings into makeshift care facilities or quarantine centers. Some hospitals elevate the quality of care they offer by “accommodating” their clients/patients in hotels, while awaiting their lab test results.

The Medical City has partnered with Robinsons Hotels and Resorts to provide a seamless and convenient healthcare experience for every Filipino with its Hotel and Travel Care Packages. The Hotel Care Package 1 is recommended to those who plan to have their ECLIA Serological (antibody) test from The Medical City. This antibody test is a highly sensitive and specific chemiluminescent immunoassay test intended for identifying individuals with an adaptive immune response to SARS-CoV-2, indicating recent or prior infection. And since the result will be released within 24 hours, the patient has the option to wait for the results in the comfort of Summit Hotel Magnolia and Go Hotels Ortigas Center, which are 20 minutes and 8 minutes away, respectively, from The Medical City.

For only P4,750 net per person (single occupancy), enjoy an overnight stay in a single room with highspeed Wi-Fi, international and local TV channels. Packed meals are included (full-board). Just add P2,500 if you wish to stay for another night.

Package 2 (three days/two nights) is priced at P11,000 per person (single occupancy). Stay for two nights in a single room with full board (packed meals), high-speed Wi-Fi connection and international and local TV channels.
Robinsons Equitable Tower, ADB cor. Poveda Ave., Pasig City, Philippines A Robinsons Land Development • www.robinsonshotels.com

This package is ideal to those who are required to take the RT-PCR test, which is considered as the gold standard for confirming the presence of SARS-CoV-2, since the results will be released after two days.

The Travel Care Package, on the other hand, is designed for OFWs, seafarers and balikbayans, who are required to undergo swab test (RT-PCR) and have to wait for their test results and clearance to be able to return home. For P12,300 net per person (single occupancy), services include private car pickup service from airport to hotel or hotel to airport; a two-night stay in a single room, full board (packed meals), high-speed Wi-Fi and international and local TV channels.

Under the new normal, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts has elevated its standard of hygiene and cleanliness protocols with the “Circle of Clean” seal. Based on World Health Organization (WHO) and Department of Health’s new normal protocols, Circle of Clean provides a worry-free stay experience for guests from pre-arrival to post-departure touchpoint implemented in all Go Hotels and Summit Hotels and Resorts around the Philippines.

To avail of the Travel Care Package, call Robinsons Hotels and Resorts at least three days from date of arrival. Send back the online guest information sheet with required information at reservations@gohotels.ph or reservations@summithotels.ph. You will receive confirmation of your booking and your COVID-19 test schedule, which you can show at the airport. Upon arrival at the hotel, show the confirmation email to the front desk during check in. Rates are inclusive of taxes and service charge. Full prepayment is required at the time of booking.

For inquiries or reservations, call RHR Happy to Care Hotlines: 0917-8887788.
